artifacts.title: Sufficiency of faith profession for visible church membership

matches.evidence: CCB found proposed overtures conflicting with BCO because the only required profession for church membership is faith in Jesus Christ, with the session judging qualifications.

artifacts.title: Proposed membership-transfer vows misusing 'profession of faith'

matches.evidence: A Southeast Alabama overture adding transfer-of-membership procedures was in conflict because it equated 'profession of faith' with doctrinal subscription and contained internal procedural contradictions.
